page.layout: One column of running text; a short marginal note in the left margin at the start of paragraph III and another at the start of paragraph IV. No running head, page number or signature. Catchword "ab" at the lower right.

main_text.p: rũ[?] Domini, Jerem.XXV.15. cum Psal.LXXV.9. עבודת מעשה זר opus alienum, operatio extranea Domini, Esaj.XXVIII.21. תולדת נכרי partus decreti, & חרון אף יהוה ira furoris Jehova, Zeph.II.2. ut plura ejusmodi ad compendium ponam.

III. Iudex so-lus Deus est. Judicia hæc exercet ille, qui καθ' ἐξοχήν eluet[?] שופט כל judex totius mundi, Genef.XVIII.25. qui κρίνει τὸν κόσμον, judicat mundum Rom.III.6. Ille nempe unus legislator est, qui servare & perdere potest, Jac.IV.12. נשפט לכל בשר judicium exercens adversus omnem carnem, Jerem.XXV.31. Unde S. ille vates Amosus provocans ad fidem Divinæ providentiæ, negat esse רעה בעיר malum ullum, afflictionem ullam in civitate, quin Jehova illud fecerit, ejus author extiterit, Amos.III.6. Et Esajas cap.XLII.24. Quis Jacobum prada, & Israelem prædatoribus exposuit? Annon Jehova, contra quem peccavimus. Hinc adeo est, quòd DEUS judicia sua executurus Prophetis se non semel obtulit specie judicis thronum insidentis, causas ac merita hominum discernentis, & à fontibus graves justasque pœnas sumentis. veluti 1.Reg.XXII.19. Esaj.VI.2.3. &c. Ezech.I.24.25. &c. Daniel.VII.13.14. Apocal.IV.4. &c. quódque Jerem.XXV.15. &c. Jehova per prophetam omnibus gentibus calicem iræ furoris sui propinat: in cujus manu etiam Psal.LXXV.9. calix esse dicitur מלא מסך πλήρης κεκερασμένος, plenus mixto : quódque denique ecclesia à tyrannis oppressa, Deum invocat tanquam אל נקמות Deum ultionum Psal.XCIV.1.2. Deus ultionum Jehova, Deus ultionum appare. Eleva te judex terræ, redde retributionem superbis. Res igitur suas sibi habere jubemus, qui cum Colutho, Ecclesiæ quondam Alexandrinæ Presbytero, negant, Deum mala pœna ullo modo efficere, vel procurare. De quibus ita S. Augustinus hær.65. Creat Deus mala, pœnas justissimas irrogando, quod Coluthus non videbat: non autem malas creando naturas & substantias, in quantum sunt natura & substantia, uti Florinus errabat.

IV. Et quidem Christus. Sicut autem DEUS Pater, judex ille totius mundi Filio suo, Domino & Salvatori nostro dedit regnum, omnémque potestatem in Cœlo & terra: ita eidem judicii exercendi absolutam potestatem communicavit. Neque enim Pater judicat quenquam, nempe sine filio, (quia inter utrumque, nempe Jehovam & virum צמח germen consilium pacis in fœdere gratiæ intium est, Zach.VI.12.13.) sed τὴν κρίσιν πᾶσαν δέδωκε τῷ υἱῷ, omne judicium dedit filio, Joh.V.22. Christi nempe est ἀντέξον[?] suum impertiri cui velit, & quos velit ab

page.notes: Left margin note "Iudex solus Deus est." is printed as "Iudex so- / lus Deus / est." and is given as one note. The first line's opening word is a worn abbreviation read as "rũ" with doubt. Hebrew and Greek are copied as seen; the Greek word after "Christi nempe est" and the verb after "cluet" are doubtful. The Hebrew in the top lines is printed right to left and was copied in that order. The last line of the page ends with the catchword "ab" and the text continues on the next page. The note beside paragraph III is a marginal note, so it is marked as a note, not as a footnote.
